rationale.faithfulness: Failed robustly: rivals co-move positively in every content variant and are friendly in stance; no conflict-coded negative couplings anywhere, including Opus 5's role change and chess opponents. The stance channel's unbalanced residuals fit the glass side of tau3(dc) but are non-specific (SK vs heterogeneous ferro) and unrelated to conflict. 1c: rivals' homophily is read-gated (not convergence); the validated stance channel is underpowered and the 1b stance-balance signature does not replicate.
rationale.usefulness: A clean negative for mixed-motive swarms: conflicting incentives do not produce conflict couplings, in topic or stance; assigned roles pin topics and same-objective agents converge. The rival contrast, tau3(dc) and the calibrated stance null port to other logs.
